name: Algator vs Sharkz
storyline:
Algator and Sharkz are enjoying a well-deserved taco in their retro lair when the alarm sounds. Guivarch and Kerberiou, straight out of the code's deep swamps, seize the precious Eminem vinyl records and cut off the RedBull supply. The two heroes spring onto the neon platforms to secure the first sector.

The arcade city streets are locked down. Jonathan and Vista unleash waves of absurd enemies armed with Brawl Stars stars. Algator triggers his Dash to dodge through projectiles, while Sharkz chains combos to recover the creator code hidden atop a tower of M&M's.

Just as the team thinks they've regained control, Timeo emerges with an overpowered army, triggering the Endless Survival protocol. Trapped in a never-ending arena, our two protagonists must harness the power of giant pears and €20 bills to unlock their ultimate attacks and break free.

The bosses unite for a chaotic final showdown in the heart of The Banger Empire. Legendary dialogue flies back and forth, retro-futuristic synth music swells, and only a flawless combo streak will let Algator and Sharkz etch their names at the top of the leaderboard.
